responsibility: Contains the declarative rule tables used by the RVV `vsetvl` pass to reason about demand compatibility, fusion, and availability. Its macro-driven entries encode when AVL/SEW/LMUL/ratio/tail-policy/mask-policy demands are incompatible, how compatible demands can be fused into a new requirement, and which demand transitions are unavailable, separating policy data from the procedural pass implementation in riscv-vsetvl.cc.
same_name_distinction: Among the `riscv-vsetvl` files, this `.def` file provides macro-driven policy tables for the pass, encoding incompatibility, fusion, and unavailability rules for AVL/SEW/LMUL/ratio/tail-policy/mask-policy demand combinations. Unlike `riscv-vsetvl.cc`, it does not walk RTL or transform code, and unlike `riscv-vsetvl.h`, it does not declare the pass data structures.
